title: 10. Exercises: Topic 5: Abstraction - Exercises
summary: Create an abstract Vehicle class with abstract methods for start_engine(), stop_engine(), and get_fuel_efficiency().
objectives: Solve the Topic 5: Abstraction - Exercises exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercise 1: Abstract Vehicle System
sections.body:
Create an abstract `Vehicle` class with abstract methods for `start_engine()`, `stop_engine()`, and `get_fuel_efficiency()`. Implement subclasses:
- `Car` with specific engine behavior and fuel efficiency calculation
- `Motorcycle` with different engine characteristics
- `Truck` with heavy-duty engine and cargo capacity
- Demonstrate polymorphic behavior with a vehicle fleet

sections.title: Exercise 2: Abstract Data Structure Interface
sections.body:
Create an abstract `DataStructure` class with abstract methods:
- `add(item)`, `remove(item)`, `contains(item)`, `size()`, `clear()`
- Implement `Stack`, `Queue`, `LinkedList`, and `BinaryTree` subclasses
- Each subclass should have specific behavior while following the common interface
- Create a data structure manager that works with any implementation

sections.title: Exercise 3: Abstract File Processor
sections.body:
Create an abstract `FileProcessor` class with abstract methods:
- `read()`, `write(data)`, `validate()`, `get_metadata()`
- Implement `TextProcessor`, `ImageProcessor`, `AudioProcessor` subclasses
- Each processor should handle different file formats and validation rules
- Create a batch processor that can handle multiple file types

sections.title: Exercise 4: Abstract Authentication System
sections.body:
Create an abstract `Authenticator` class with abstract methods:
- `authenticate(credentials)`, `validate_token(token)`, `refresh_token(token)`
- Implement `PasswordAuthenticator`, `OAuthAuthenticator`, `BiometricAuthenticator`
- Each authenticator should have different authentication logic
- Create a multi-factor authentication system

sections.title: Exercise 5: Abstract Notification System
sections.body:
Create an abstract `NotificationService` class with abstract methods:
- `send(message, recipient)`, `format_message(message)`, `validate_recipient(recipient)`
- Implement `EmailService`, `SMSService`, `PushNotificationService`
- Each service should handle different message formats and delivery methods
- Create a notification manager that can use multiple services

sections.title: Exercise 6: Abstract Database Connection
sections.body:
Create an abstract `DatabaseConnection` class with abstract methods:
- `connect()`, `execute_query(query)`, `commit()`, `rollback()`, `close()`
- Implement `MySQLConnection`, `PostgreSQLConnection`, `SQLiteConnection`
- Each connection should handle different SQL dialects and connection parameters
- Create a database manager that can work with any database type

sections.title: Exercise 7: Abstract Payment Gateway
sections.body:
Create an abstract `PaymentGateway` class with abstract methods:
- `process_payment(amount, payment_info)`, `refund(transaction_id)`, `get_transaction_status(id)`
- Implement `StripeGateway`, `PayPalGateway`, `BankGateway`
- Each gateway should handle different payment processing logic
- Create a payment processor that can route payments to different gateways

sections.title: Exercise 8: Abstract Report Generator
sections.body:
Create an abstract `ReportGenerator` class with abstract methods:
- `generate_report(data)`, `format_data(data)`, `export_report(report, format)`
- Implement `SalesReportGenerator`, `InventoryReportGenerator`, `FinancialReportGenerator`
- Each generator should create different types of reports with specific calculations
- Create a reporting system that can generate multiple report types

sections.title: Exercise 9: Abstract Cache System
sections.body:
Create an abstract `Cache` class with abstract methods:
- `get(key)`, `set(key, value, ttl)`, `delete(key)`, `clear()`, `size()`
- Implement `MemoryCache`, `RedisCache`, `FileCache`
- Each cache should have different storage mechanisms and performance characteristics
- Create a cache manager that can use different cache implementations

sections.title: Exercise 10: Abstract Logging System
sections.body:
Create an abstract `Logger` class with abstract methods:
- `log(level, message, context)`, `set_level(level)`, `get_logs()`, `clear_logs()`
- Implement `FileLogger`, `DatabaseLogger`, `ConsoleLogger`, `NetworkLogger`
- Each logger should handle different output destinations and formatting
- Create a logging system that can use multiple loggers simultaneously

sections.title: Optional Challenges
sections.body:
### Challenge 1: Abstract Plugin System
Create a plugin system with:
- Abstract `Plugin` base class with lifecycle methods
- Plugin discovery and loading mechanism
- Plugin dependency management
- Hot-swappable plugin architecture

### Challenge 2: Abstract Workflow Engine
Build a workflow engine with:
- Abstract `WorkflowStep` class for individual steps
- Abstract `Workflow` class for orchestrating steps
- Conditional branching and parallel execution
- Workflow persistence and recovery

### Challenge 3: Abstract Configuration System
Create a configuration system with:
- Abstract `ConfigurationProvider` class
- Multiple sources (file, database, environment, API)
- Configuration validation and schema enforcement
- Dynamic configuration updates

### Challenge 4: Abstract Event System
Implement an event system with:
- Abstract `Event` and `EventHandler` classes
- Event routing and filtering
- Asynchronous event processing
- Event persistence and replay

### Challenge 5: Abstract API Client
Build an API client framework with:
- Abstract `APIClient` class
- Different authentication methods
- Request/response handling
- Rate limiting and retry logic
